companyName.title: Company name
companyName.description: Company name to research. When website/LinkedIn are omitted, the Actor searches the web for matching companies.

website.title: Website
website.description: Optional company website or domain (e.g. https://apify.com or apify.com). Skips discovery and enriches this domain.

linkedinUrl.title: LinkedIn URL
linkedinUrl.description: Optional LinkedIn company page URL used as a seed/corroboration signal.

maxResults.title: Max results
maxResults.description: Maximum number of company matches to return when searching by name.

countryCode.title: Country code
countryCode.description: Optional two-letter country code to bias search results (e.g. us, in, gb).
